ValidationRule.description: Prevents dispatches from bypassing technician allocation rules when updating the ticket lifecycle status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Repair_Status__c,"On Hold"), ISPICKVAL(Repair_Status__c,"In Progress"), ISPICKVAL(Repair_Status__c,"Resolved"), ISPICKVAL(Repair_Status__c,"Closed") ), ISBLANK(Technician__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An active Technician must be assigned to the Repair Request before status can be advanced to In Progress ,on hold, resolved or Closed.
